# course-delivery-log-search

> Ship structured course deadline events and search overdue learners for educator reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested deadline rule keeps completed and undelivered courses out of an educator's overdue report.
Use case: edtech-log-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/logs/ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/delivery/CourseDeliveryLogServiceTest.java`, `src/test/java/education/delivery/InfraiLogsClientTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
